steps.content: Earl clearly wants to use you for some purpose, and you need more information of other sorts as well—for example, information about these gangsters.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=30>... How did you spot these rotten fish?</size>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=30>Be careful. The Yagyu members are well-dressed scumbags with no morals at all. If this guy claims to be an ordinary employee, don't believe him.</size>

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: We're from Yagyu Limited, a long-established registered company in the West District that operates with integrity. We're not a gang.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=30>Bah.</size>

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are you following us?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: I pay attention to you. Until tonight, I hadn't seen you in Syndicate, sir.
steps.female_content: I pay attention to you. Until tonight, I hadn't seen you in Syndicate, ma'am.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: You're not with the Legion, are you, sir?
steps.female_content: You're not with the Legion, are you, ma'am?

steps.content: You use the lie you've made up: You're a newbie sheriff who'd just won Ted's favor, but then Ted was killed by SALVA. After escaping from the clinic, you unfortunately ended up in the Legion's hands.

You stress the fact that the Legion took you to the crypt because they seemed to think you were hiding some information about the inheritance. But knowing nothing at all, you only want to ensure your own safety and escape.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=30>No kidding, you'll fit in Syndicate quite well.</size>
Upon hearing your explanation, the Yagyu executive's eyes brighten up briefly and a wicked smile creeps up on his face.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: That's why you drew that mark to ask for help... It's very brave and resourceful of you to keep resisting, having already faced that woman.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: We can help you. Once we wipe out the entire Legion, Earl's curse will vanish automatically. You'll be free then.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: The gang alliance has already lain an ambush in the central elevator. That place will be the Legion's grave.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: That woman is overconfident. She thinks the inheritance is already in her hands, but she doesn't know about...
He chuckles coldly and lowers his voice.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: ...Her subordinate, the Sinner who escaped from SALVA and went out to do recon for her. She's supposed to be trapped underground now, half-dead.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Zoya has always been a jinx. Those who are close to her never end up well. If we're lucky, today may become the death anniversary of the whole Legion.
...R is half-dead?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: You seem very concerned about her?
Facing his doubtful look, you steady your emotion and change the question.

options: I'm wondering what I can do.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: ...Haha, why don't you come with us now. Once we're back to our base, we'll discuss things in detail.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: No need to worry about that bomb, we can fake a combat scene to make him believe you were forced to leave instead of fleeing on your own...
Is this a chance to get away from the Legion? But will Earl and Zoya be fooled by the staged evidence?
Or, perhaps even if they believe you're forced, he'll still detonate the bomb without any hesitation?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: You're a valuable talent, we'd like you to join us. You've <color=#fb9259>trained</color> two Sinners so well, no wonder you're Ted's friend.
As you're still considering, hearing Ted's name suddenly startles you.

options: What does it have to do with Ted?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: In fact... Yagyu provides some special services too.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Sinners like Zoya have completely fallen. But those like the two beside you... Sinners this age can become very useful if they're properly trained.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Ted has had excellent achievements in this aspect.

options: Are you talking about a gray-haired Sinner girl?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: You've met her? Yes, in fact, we sold her to Ted. We only knew Sinners were dangerous at that time, we never expected they could be trained like that...

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: They've got great power. More importantly, they obey and only take orders from you. Isn't that even better than the Mania weapon?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: What a shame they were destroyed in SALVA yesterday. Otherwise, they would have stood here today and fought alongside us in the final battle.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: In order to defeat the Legion, we need stronger power... Something even stronger than the Mania weapon...
He smiles at you, but you're slowly clenching your fists, your nails digging into your palms uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: What do you think, sir? Surely these two beside you can...
steps.female_content: So, what do you think, ma'am? Surely these two beside you can...

options: This is your true purpose, isn't it?

steps.content: You don't care if I live or die, as long as you get the two Sinners.
The Yagyu executive's smile disappears.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, relax your hands. Your palms are bleeding.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Chief?
Hella grabs the pipe and stands before you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't force yourself if you can't stand it anymore.

options: You guys are right, enough role play from me.
